lines.personal_line: Your team's work in building a full Swiss import, sales and marketing service for European brand manufacturers speaks for itself. We would value the opportunity to present our sugar free range and to hear whether you feel it could sit alongside the brands you already represent.

We have great respect for the way your team serves the Swiss food retail trade, from small customers on 24 hour delivery to full truckloads. With such established reach across Swiss retail, we would be honoured if you would consider whether a sugar free range could have a place in your portfolio.

We hold your team in high regard for its IFS Logistic and IFS Broker certified operation, handling around 5,500 tonnes a year. We would be grateful for the opportunity to discuss whether our sugar free range could be a worthwhile addition to your business.

Your range, from branded European confectionery and snacks to spreads and gourmet products, reflects a careful choice of brands for the Swiss trade. We would welcome the chance to present our sugar free range for your consideration, should you see a place for it.
